# thoth_policy (Resource)

Manages a policy rule in one environment (dev or prod). A rule created with a key that is not an org admin's starts pending until an org admin approves it; status shows that.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enforcement` (String) monitor, review or block.
- `environment` (String) dev or prod. Changing it replaces the rule; promote a dev rule with the configuration preview or the API.
- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `type` (String) scope, budget, risk or data_access.

### Optional

- `applied_to` (List of String) Agent IDs the rule applies to, or ["all"] (the default).
- `description` (String) Rule description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule applies. Turning a rule on needs an org admin's key; a pending rule stays pending until approved.
- `rules_json` (String) The rule's conditions as a JSON object, for example with jsonencode().

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Resource ID: environment/policy_id.
- `policy_id` (String) Policy rule ID assigned by Thoth.
- `status` (String) pending, active, disabled or rejected.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID from provider configuration.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
